system.description:
Effect: Upgrades a bomb cypher (such as a fiery bomb or shrapnel bomb) to have long range and create an additional delayed effect. When the upgraded cypher explodes, it also creates four additional bombs that each move a short distance in a different random direction, then explode on the next round in the same way as the original (unmodified) bomb cypher. Once a cluster bomb cypher is used to upgrade another cypher, the cluster bomb is expended and no longer counts toward your cypher limit.

Genre Items: scroll of metamagical destruction (fantasy); bomb cascade (sci-fi) Some GMs might decide that if a character finds a cluster bomb cypher, it’s actually an existing bomb cypher that’s already been upgraded with a cluster bomb cypher.
